product.allergens: celery, eggs, gluten, milk, sesame seeds, soybeans, sulphur dioxide and sulphites
product.ingredients_text:
NOODLE: Wheat flour, vegetable oil, tapioca starch, acidity regulator (500(i), 501(i)), stabilizer (452(i), 412), antioxidant (319) and colouring (102).
SEASONING POWDER: Sugar, salt, flavor enhancer (621), garlic powder, onion powder, synthetic chicken flavor (contain flavor enhancer (631, 627)), pepper powder.
SEASONING OIL: Vegetable oil and onion.
SWEET SOY SAUCE: Sugar, water, soybean, wheat, salt, sesame oil.
CHILI SAUCE: Chili, water, sugar, salt, thickener, acidity regulator, flavor enhancer (621, 631, 627), synthetic flavor, preservatives (211, 223).
FRIED ONION (contain antioxidant (319)).
CONTAINS: Gluten, egg, dairy, soybean, sulphite, celery and sesame.
May Contain: Peanuts, crustacean, fish, tree nuts and mustard.
product.ingredients_text_id: Tepung terigu, minyak nabati, saus cabai (4,7%) (mengandung pengawet natrium benzoat dan natrium metabisulfit), kecap manis (mengandung kedelai dan gandum), bawang goreng (2.3%), tepung tapioka, garam, gula, bumbu mi goreng (0,8%) (mengandung antioksidan alfa tokoferol, tokoferol campuran pekat dan BHA), penguat rasa (mononatrium glutamat, dinatrium inosinat dan guanilat), perisa sintetik (mengandung telur, susu, antioksidan (asam askorbat, alfa tokoferol dan tokoferol campuran pekat)), bawang putih bubuk, pengatur keasaman, penstabil (nabati dan fosfat), lada bubuk, vitamin (A, B1, B6, B12, Niasin, Asam Folat dan Pantotenat), pewarna alami karamel I, mineral (zat besi), antioksidan TBHQ dan pewarna sintetik tartrazin Cl 19140.
